title: Homogeneous realization and degree projection of square-zero tensor boundaries
statement:
Let $j:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes with ideal $J=j.\ker$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and let $L$ be an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Assume $J^2=0$ [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers], the derived-category instances for the canonical module section boundaries [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, lem-sc-module-section-boundary-exact], and short exactness of the canonical unit kernel sequence for each $L^d$. Fix $n\ge0$ and the canonical section and coefficient comparisons $D=(a_e,k_e)$ of [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit], with $D$ equal to their explicit construction. Put $F=j^*(J\otimes L^n)$, $N=(j^*L)^n$, $H=H^1(Z,-)$, and let $b_e:H(F\otimes N^e)\simeq H^1(X,\ker\eta_{L^{n(e+1)}})$ be induced by $k_e$ [def-pc-module-pullback, lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction, def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. For $y:\mathcal O_Z\to N^{e+1}$ set $\Delta_e(y)=\partial_{n(e+1)}((y;a_e^{-1})(1))$, with the canonical section boundary of [def-sc-module-cohomology-boundary, lem-sc-module-section-boundary-exact]. For every $e\ge0$, $f:\mathcal O_Z\to N$ and $x:\mathcal O_Z\to N^{e+1}$ there exist commutative $\mathcal O_X$-algebra sheaves $B,C$, a morphism $p:B\to C$, and a module sheaf $K$ with inclusion $i:K\to B$, such that $0\to K\xrightarrow{i} B\xrightarrow{p} C\to0$ is short exact and products of two local sections in the kernel of $p$ vanish [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-ringed-space-algebra-module]. For every compatible injective resolution presentation of this sequence, with a degreewise and global-sections short exact horseshoe [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and for every local quotient action $\sigma$, global action $\mu$, induced cohomology action $\rho$ and additive map $\partial$ satisfying: $i(\sigma(p(b))(z))=b\,i(z)$ on all opens; $\sigma$ commutes with restriction; $\mu$ evaluates as the restricted local action; $\rho(c)=H^1(X,\mu(c))$; and $\partial$ is the transported snake boundary preceded by the canonical sections-to-degree-zero comparison [pqf-def-cohomology], there exist $s,t\in\Gamma(X,C)$ and additive maps $P:H^1(X,K)\to H(F\otimes N^{e+1})$, $P_x:H^1(X,K)\to H(F\otimes N^e)$, $P_f:H^1(X,K)\to H(F\otimes N^0)$ satisfying
$$P(\partial(st))=b_{e+1}^{-1}\Delta_{e+1}(\lambda^{-1};f\otimes x),\quad P_x(\partial(t))=b_e^{-1}\Delta_e(x),\quad P_f(\partial(s))=b_0^{-1}\Delta_0(f^{\otimes1}).$$
For every $z\in H^1(X,K)$ they also satisfy
$$P(\rho(s)z)=H(\mathrm{mulTensorPowSection}(f,F,e,1))(P_xz),\qquad P(\rho(t)z)=H(\rho_F^{-1};\mathrm{id}_F\otimes x)(H(\rho_F)(P_fz)).$$
No equation expanding $\partial(st)$ as a sum is assumed or asserted.

proof.text: Obtain the purely algebraic TensorGradedPresentation. Its short exact sequence and square-zero property give the required B,C,p,I,i. Define s,t by the explicit homogeneous inclusions and P,Px,Pf by cohomology of the degree projections followed by inverse coefficient comparisons.

Apply the boundary-projection theorem directly to the supplied compatible resolution presentation and transported snake boundary. Compose its degreewise equation with the homogeneous product projection or diagonal input projection. These three chains give the three boundary equations.

Apply the homogeneous quotient action comparison theorem to the given local, global and cohomology actions. Its two equations are exactly the final conjuncts for the explicitly defined P,Px,Pf. Combine the three boundary equations and these two action equations.
